channel.title: Texas Legislature - Today's Filed Bills in the Senate
channel.description: Bills filed on 11/17/2026. An appearance of a bill on this list is a result of it being filed by a representative or senator.

item.title: SB 401 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Paxton
item.description: Relating to the definition of fetal death certificate.

item.title: SB 402 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Paxton
item.description: Relating to the requirements for the operational plan for certain general residential operations licensed by the Health and Human Services Commission.

item.title: SB 403 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Paxton
item.description: Relating to the transfer of students between public schools.

item.title: SB 404 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Cook, Molly
item.description: Relating to the authority of a municipality to alter speed limits.

item.title: SB 405 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to municipal civilian complaint review boards for peace officer misconduct in certain municipalities.

item.title: SB 406 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to the retention and required disclosure under the public information law of certain complaints alleging official oppression.

item.title: SB 407 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to including certain demographic information in federal incident-based reporting of information and statistics concerning offenses committed in this state.

item.title: SB 408 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to the eligibility of certain criminal defendants for an order of nondisclosure of criminal history record information.

item.title: SB 409 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to the applicability of the death penalty to a capital offense committed by a person with an intellectual disability.

item.title: SB 410 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to the expunction of records and files related to conduct constituting a misdemeanor offense engaged in by a child.

item.title: SB 411 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to increasing the criminal penalty for certain acts of official oppression.

item.title: SB 412 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to processes to ensure continuity of care and services for certain offenders receiving services from a local mental health authority or local behavioral health authority.

item.title: SB 413 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to the payment of certain fines and costs by a defendant.

item.title: SB 414 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to job interview restrictions for releasees from the Texas Department of Criminal Justice.

item.title: SB 415 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Zaffirini
item.description: Relating to prohibiting a registered sex offender in certain circumstances from going within 2,500 feet of the residence of a victim of any offense committed by the offender for which the offender is subject to registration.

item.title: SB 416 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Zaffirini
item.description: Relating to automatic orders of nondisclosure of criminal history record information for certain misdemeanor defendants following successful completion of a period of deferred adjudication community supervision.
